title: WaterColor "Whit's End" 1848 East County Highway 30A #4
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- On the Gulf- Steps away from the WaterColor Beach Club- Private community pool (only those staying in the Beachside Condos have access)- Direct access to separate private condo pool- 6- Passenger Low Speed Vehicle- 3 Adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Recharge at Whit’s End—a 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo tucked in the resort-style WaterColor community. Comfortably accommodating 10 guests, this retreat is only steps from the dune walkover at WaterColor Inn and a 2-minute stroll to WaterColor Beach Club. Complementing WaterColor’s many pools and luxurious amenities, guests can also enjoy the designated community pool. Savor leisurely days poolside and indulgent nights admiring the Gulf sunset from the balcony!A picturesque sitting space welcomes guests to the first level, featuring slip-covered furnishings, TV, and a queen Murphy bed for extra accommodations. Step onto the shaded porch with a bistro set and access to community walking paths. The cheerful primary bedroom boasts a king bed and private bathroom—with TVs in every bedroom! A hallway washer and dryer adds convenience.Natural light from multi-level bay windows fills the stairwell leading to the second level, where golden hardwood floors and sea-inspired décor set the scene for stress-free days. In the living area, an oversized sectional tempts guests to sprawl out and unwind with a movie night on the Blu-ray player. French doors open onto a welcoming balcony with views of the lush landscaping and glittering Gulf. Share indulgent dinners around the 6-person round table, with extra seating available at the 3-stool breakfast bar. The spacious kitchen, well-equipped with high-end appliances and granite countertops, makes meal preparation easy. Off the kitchen, a second balcony hosts a 4-person alfresco table with lovely lake views. The thoughtfully outfitted primary bedroom offers a plush king bed and private bathroom, while the charming guest bedroom provides 2 queen beds.Whit’s End provides on-site parking for 1 vehicle, a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle, and 3 complimentary bikes. For beach access, walk to WaterColor Inn, located on Goldenrod Circle, or visit the WaterColor Beach Club. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Living Area: Queen Murphy BedSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Soaking Tub Separate*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and management fines.Please Note: Effective March 2024, all low-speed vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company. Rentals are limited to 60 carts community-wide, with a maximum of 1 per home on a first-come, first-serve basis. Disclaimer: WaterColor condos lack exterior outlets for low-speed vehicle charging. Due to safety concerns, 360 Blue is unable to provide extension cords. Guests renting a low-speed vehicle should coordinate charging needs with the rental company.
